headline: Technical fault at FSRU disrupts gas supply in Bangladesh
summary: A technical glitch at the Floating Storage Regasification Unit (FSRU) has caused a sudden shortage of gas across the country.
details: A technical fault at the Floating Storage Regasification Unit (FSRU) has led to a significant disruption in the gas supply across Bangladesh.
The issue occurred at the FSRU, which is critical for importing and regasifying liquefied natural gas (LNG) for the national grid.
The Energy and Mineral Resources Minister has confirmed the cause of the gas shortage, attributing it to this technical failure.
Authorities are working to resolve the technical glitch to restore full gas supply to the industries and households as soon as possible.
caption:
A sudden gas shortage is hitting Bangladesh. The cause? A technical fault at the FSRU.

A technical fault at the Floating Storage Regasification Unit (FSRU) has led to a significant disruption in the gas supply across Bangladesh.

The issue occurred at the FSRU, which is critical for importing and regasifying liquefied natural gas (LNG) for the national grid.

The Energy and Mineral Resources Minister has confirmed the cause of the gas shortage, attributing it to this technical failure.

Authorities are working to resolve the technical glitch to restore full gas supply to the industries and households as soon as possible.

#Bangladesh #GasCrisis #Energy #FSRU #FuelShortage

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Somoy News
